text: In the EU, MiCA exemptions for non-transferable utility tokens spare LER airdrops from white paper and issuer authorization requirements, but only so long as the rewards remain non-redeemable for fiat and confined to closed-loop merchant ecosystems.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
abstract: In the EU, MiCA's exemptions for non-transferable utility tokens ensure that LER voucher rewards, distributed as airdrops, avoid white paper and issuer authorization requirements, as long as LER remain non-redeemable for fiat and confined to closed-loop merchant ecosystems.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: acceptance confined to closed-loop merchant networks
